name: Should I finish my basement or build a home addition to add living space?

mainEntity.name: Should I finish my basement or build a home addition to add living space?

acceptedAnswer.text: A finished basement transforms existing square footage beneath your home, while a home addition builds new structural square footage outside or above the existing envelope. Basement remodeling avoids excavation, exterior siding, and new roofing, making it a cost-effective way to add bedrooms, entertainment spaces, or bathrooms. Conversely, an addition is necessary when you need main-level living space, natural sunlight, or lack adequate ceiling height in an unfinished basement. Both options offer great utility depending on your family's daily needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Finish your basement to gain lower-level space without exterior structural construction, or build an addition if you require ground-level access and more natural light.
